Hi Paula — thanks for the details and sorry for the friction.

Quick troubleshooting checklist that usually covers this class of problem:
- Can you open the original invite in desktop Gmail (not the mobile app) and use View > Show original to inspect the href? Conversation-threading sometimes wraps long hrefs with soft breaks.
- Try copying the link target (long-press / copy link) and paste into incognito browser; if it contains extra "forwarded=" or "gthread=" query params we suspect client-side rewriting.
- Workaround: we can resend a plain-text invite with the token on its own line (no button) or a short-lived one-time URL.

Ben, can you generate a fresh Coupa invite token for Talon Components and attach the .eml so Paula can try both the web and mobile clients? If we can reproduce the header rewrite we should file a support ticket with Gmail.

Paula — if you can, please attach a screenshot of the broken page (errors or the URL bar). That will help us confirm whether the token was lost or altered.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
